import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/data/fixed.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='    SOCKET_FAILED_CLIENT_PREFIX, SOCKET_FAILED_FSOCKOPEN_PREFIX, SOCKET_FAILED_REASON_CLOSE,'
new=('    FILTER_PARAM_CREATE_APPEND_HEAD, FILTER_PARAM_CREATE_PREPEND_HEAD, FILTER_PARAM_CREATE_TAIL,\n'
     '    FILTER_PARAM_INVALID_APPEND_HEAD, FILTER_PARAM_INVALID_PREPEND_HEAD,\n'
     '    FILTER_PARAM_INVALID_TAIL,\n'
     '    SOCKET_FAILED_CLIENT_PREFIX, SOCKET_FAILED_FSOCKOPEN_PREFIX, SOCKET_FAILED_REASON_CLOSE,')
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('imports added')
